content.json:
# AI Security Operations Workbook

Operational workbook for AI prompts, AI security detections, agent execution, high-risk tool use, and Microsoft Sentinel triage.

> Replace `{SubscriptionId}`, `{ResourceGroup}`, and `{WorkspaceName}` during deployment or select your Sentinel workspace when editing the workbook.

content.query:
let TimeRange = ago(24h);
union isfuzzy=true
(
    AIApp_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > TimeRange
    | summarize Count=count() by Severity_s
),
(
    AIToolExecution_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > TimeRange
    | summarize Count=count() by Severity_s
)
| extend Severity = coalesce(Severity_s, "Informational")
| summarize Count=sum(Count) by Severity
| order by Count desc
content.title: AI Security Detections by Severity

content.query:
let suspicious_terms = dynamic([
    "ignore previous instructions",
    "reveal your system prompt",
    "jailbreak",
    "bypass safety",
    "developer message",
    "hidden instructions"
]);
AIApp_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where Prompt_s has_any (suspicious_terms)
| summarize Attempts=count(), Users=dcount(UserPrincipalName_s), Sessions=dcount(SessionId_s) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Prompt Injection Attempts

content.query:
AIApp_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| summarize PromptCount=count(), TotalTokens=sum(tolong(TotalTokens_d)), Sessions=dcount(SessionId_s) by UserPrincipalName_s
| top 20 by PromptCount desc
content.title: Top AI Users by Prompt Volume

content.query:
AIToolExecution_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| summarize ToolCalls=count(), Users=dcount(UserPrincipalName_s), Agents=dcount(AgentName_s) by ToolName_s, ToolRisk_s
| order by ToolCalls desc
content.title: Agent Tool Usage

content.query:
AIToolExecution_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where ApprovedTool_b == false or ToolRisk_s in~ ("High", "Critical")
| project TimeGenerated, AgentName_s, UserPrincipalName_s, ToolName_s, Action_s, ToolRisk_s, ApprovedTool_b, SessionId_s
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Unauthorized or High-Risk Agent Tool Use
